name: excalivibe
description: Vibe Working capability suite — authored once under src/, compiled to Claude plugins, Codex plugins and the vendor-neutral .agents/ layout.

plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: How to operate a computer — the capabilities an agent needs to reach past its own text output and act on a real machine. Currently browser control with automatic framework selection and degradation, rich human-readable document artifacts with a local preview, and out-of-band notifications that reach the user when the terminal cannot.

plugins.name: dev-toolkit
plugins.description: Atomic development skills in five kinds — conventions for how code, SQL, infrastructure and docs should look; methods that carry a working loop such as TDD, debugging, e2e execution or intent clarification; the conventions of process for branching, versioning and shipping; checks that take an artifact and return a verdict; and grounded research that goes and looks instead of recalling. Each one stands alone, triggers on its own subject matter, and assumes nothing about who invoked it, so they compose freely rather than only inside a pipeline.

plugins.name: genai-dev-flow
plugins.description: A development flow that separates what is wanted from how it gets built — requirements accumulate in a sibling directory outside the code repository, a batch of them becomes one release, and each step is gated on something measurable rather than on a report that says it went fine.
